name: com.streethawk.library.push.SHGcmListenerService
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Google Cloud Messaging starts this StreetHawk Service when a push arrives. It verifies the configured sender and message ID, saves the message, and broadcasts it for StreetHawk's push handler.
disableEffect: StreetHawk push notifications will stop arriving through Google Cloud Messaging.
